core_obligations: The authors use an integer-valued intersection polynomial to construct a symmetric fitting matrix with diagonal one and controlled rank, simultaneously over every finite field, then combine threshold Kneser graphs and entropy asymptotics to obtain odd-cycle-free graphs of sublinear minrank for all sufficiently large orders. The characteristic-independent symmetric construction is retained as the essential nonstandard mechanism. Triangle-free binary orthogonality and vector-coloring consequences are not additional counts.
